variants.title: Compton scattering from copper: the Klein-Nishina cross-section
variants.sample: Copper rod, 1 cm diameter and 3 cm long
variants.unknown: d sigma / d Omega per electron and the total cross-section
variants.note: The copper rod has 5.8e24 electrons (8.96 g/cm3, Z/A 0.45636), five times fewer than the aluminium one, so the counting time is four times longer. Per electron the cross-section comes out the same as for aluminium. Absorption inside the rod is not modelled.

source.title: NIST composition table: copper density 8.96 g/cm3, Z/A = 0.45636

variants.aim: From the counts in the scattered photopeak of Cs-137 gamma rays on a copper rod at seven angles, find d sigma / d Omega per electron, compare it with Klein-Nishina and integrate it to the total cross-section.
